senses.gloss:
ऋभु a. Ved.
—1 Skilful, clever, prudent (as an epithet of Indra, Agni, Ādityas, property
 and wealth) ऋभुमृभुक्षणो रयिम् Rv. 4. 37. 5.
—2 Handy (as a weapon).
—3 Shining far.

ऋभु + .{@-भुः@}
—1 A deity, divinity; a god (dwelling in heaven).
—2 The god who is worshipped by the gods; ऋभवो नाम तत्रान्ये देवानामपि
 देवताः Mb. 3. 261. 19.
—3 A class of the attendants of gods.
—4 An artist, smith, especially a coach-builder (रथकार).
—5 N. of three semi-divine beings called Ṛbhu, Vibhvan and Vāja, sons
 of Sudhanvan, a descendant of Aṅgiras, who were so called from the name
 of the eldest son. [Through their performance of good works they obtained
 divinity, exercised superhuman powers, and became entitled to worship.
 They are supposed to dwell in the Solar sphere, and are the artists who
 formed the horses of Indra, the carriage of the Aśvins, and the miraculous
 cow of Bṛhaspati. They made their aged parents young, and constructed
 four cups at a sacrifice from the one cup of Tvaṣṭṛ, who as the proper
 artificer of the gods, was in this respect their rival. They appear generally
 as accompanying Indra at the evening sacrifices. MW.].

—1 N. of Indra.
—2 Heaven (of Indra) or paradise.
—3 The thunderbolt of Śiva.

ऋभुक्षिन् m. [ऋभुक्षः वज्रं स्वर्गो वा अस्यास्ति इनि] (Nom. ऋभुक्षाः,
 acc. pl. ऋभुक्षः)
—1 N. of Indra.
—2 N. of the Maruts; इमां मे मरुतो गिरमिमं स्तोममृभुक्षणः Rv. 8. 7. 9.
—3 A Ṛbhu in general.
—4 Governing far; reigning over Ṛbhus.
ऋभुमत् a. Skilful, prudent; आ नो यज्ञाय तक्षत ऋभुमदूयः Rv. 1. 111. 2.
